- **My own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX** — so you can write and call me there; each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Tell me whether you want that.

- **Jobs, commands, languages, voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands on this machine, learn languages and talk by voice.
